name: Demonfire Plating rank 1 reduces magic damage taken by 2% and raises Stamina by 3% (#877)
contract: Demonfire Plating rank 1 is spell 704966 -- a distinct spell ID from rank 2 (302549), which apps/coa-gameplay-test/scenarios/knight-of-xoroth-demonfire-plating-damage-and-stamina.json already covers for issue #1833; do not conflate the two. 704966 reads 'Reduces your damage taken by $s1% and increases your Stamina by $s2%.' (rank 1 tooltip: -2% damage taken, +3% Stamina, matching the installed moa_description). Effect 0 is native aura 87 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN), EffectMiscValue 126 (all magic schools: Holy/Fire/Nature/Frost/Shadow/Arcane, excludes SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_NORMAL bit 0), EffectBasePoints -3 with DieSides 1 -> -2, verified directly via csv.DictReader against /home/fab/CoaServer/reference/snapshots/ascension-data/tables/spell.csv.gz. Its handler comment is at SpellAuraEffects.cpp:152 (VERIFIED: not :150 as an earlier pass cited -- line 150 is aura 85's dispatch-table entry, two rows above), consumed at Unit.cpp:9427 and :10940 via GetTotalAuraMultiplier(SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN, ... effect->GetMiscValue() & spellProto->GetSchoolMask()), a real native consumer gated by school mask. Effect 1 is native aura 137 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE), EffectMiscValue 2 (STAT_STAMINA), EffectBasePoints 2 with DieSides 1 -> 3, handler AuraEffect::HandleModTotalPercentStat (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:202,4510) -- a fully native stat-percent aura. No script anywhere references 704966; both effects are native generic auras. The scenario probes incoming damage from Fire-school spell 524919 (Burning Blade, SchoolMask=SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_FIRE=4), which the 126 misc mask includes -- the same probe spell used by the rank 2 scenario. Stamina is asserted as the truncation-exact +2 point rise: the class's level-60 base Stamina is 99, 99*1.03=101.97 truncates to 101 (ratio 1.0202, below a 1.025-1.035 window).
